title: Map Config
desc: Configure the map service keys used by the travel guide location picker. If not configured or failed to load, the picker dialog automatically falls back to OSM keyless mode (WGS-84 coordinates). The blog-side map display is not affected by this page and always uses the keyless solution.

form.amapKeyPlaceholder: AMap Open Platform Web (JS API) Key
form.amapKeyTipAfter: , create a key of type “Web (JS API)” and paste it here. Once configured, location picking in mainland China uses AMap (GCJ-02 coordinates).
form.amapSecurityCodePlaceholder: Security key paired with the AMap Key; leave empty to keep the value stored on the server
form.amapSecurityCodeTip: Required for AMap keys applied after Dec 2021. Encrypted at rest after saving; readable only in the admin console.
form.googleKeyTip: Once configured, location picking outside mainland China uses Google Maps (WGS-84 coordinates).

message.saveSuccess: Map config updated. Takes effect the next time the picker dialog opens
